description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Max Lange Attack. Play 6.e5! and rip open the center.

drills.briefExplanation: 6.e5! d5 7.exf6 dxc4 8.Re1+ Be6 — blast, trade, and seize the file with check.
drills.description: White to play. Black plays 5...Bc5 — strike with the Max Lange 6.e5!.
drills.explanation: The Max Lange Attack: White meets the Two Knights with 6.e5!, blowing up the center. After 6...d5 7.exf6 dxc4 the position is chaos — open lines everywhere, both kings exposed, tactics on every move. White's lead in development is the tiebreaker: in open chaos, the faster army wins.
drills.name: The e5 Blast

drills.briefExplanation: 8.Re1+! Be6 9.Ng5 Qxf6 10.Nxe6 — check, hunt, capture, and win the bishop.
drills.description: White to play. The center exploded — play 8.Re1+! with check.
drills.explanation: The Max Lange in full cry: after the explosion, White plays 8.Re1+! — and after 8...Be6 9.Ng5 Qf6 comes 10.Nxe6!, winning the bishop (10...fxe6?? 11.Qh5+ wins). White's attack converts initiative directly into material.
drills.name: The Re1 Check

name: Max Lange Attack — White Tactics
